answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using graph trust propagation, routing identities through a network inlet. At each consensus pulse, seeds trace bounded random walks across endorsement graphs to score conductance, isolating fake clusters on a disconnected mesa. An attacker incurs the scarce cost of securing authentic trust edges from reputable peers rather than generating free aliases. However, this mechanism favors entrenched incumbents and penalizes legitimate newcomers.
